Name: Pokemon Dolls for Content Patcher and Alternative Textures
Author: Iceprincess98
Description:
This mod is an unofficial conversion of meme12345bunny's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2261?tab=description]Pokemon Dolls mod[/url] which now adds the plushies to Robin's shop through Content Patcher.
If the original author ever wants me to take this mod down, I will happily do so.

Update: An Alternative Texture version of the mod is now also available.
The smaller dolls replace the items called 'House Plant' and the big ones are an AT of the 'Junimo Plush' and the 'Lg. Futan Bear'.


Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52928861]froststar11[/url] and Solaria for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3594?tab=description]updating [/url]the original mod!
